author: Fingledorp
quote: What can only be described as every single terrible excess of modern gaming metastized into a single product. There is a reason nobody talks about it's writing. If this were a game by any other publisher or series it would not be getting given a tenth of the absurd leeway it has been given by critics and fans. After 1 billion dollars and 3,700 people and about 7 years of development a game coming out as unfinished as it was on launch is not acceptable by any professional metric and I doubt that Rockstar of all people plan to pull a Cyberpunk and turn it around. The several union busts, normalization of some of the most predatory pricing and advertising ever done, rumors of ai coding, and the sheer fakeness of the reception critically around this game mean I cannot in good faith give this anything but the lowest score.
